vulnerable_snapshot.summary: VULNERABLE PATTERN: every call constructs a new std::mt19937 seeded with a single 32-bit value. Effective entropy per call is bounded by the seed space (2^32 states), independent of how good the seed source appears.

fixed_snapshot.summary: FIXED PATTERN: randomness is delegated to the JS host (crypto.getRandomValues / Node crypto.randomBytes) through Emscripten EM_ASM, with a fail-closed error when no CSPRNG exists.

limitations: Static analysis of source text only; the historical WASM binary was not rebuilt.
Classification reflects the RNG layer of wallet-core's WASM port, not every code path of every extension release.
result.provenance_note: Inputs are byte-exact copies fetched from trustwallet/wallet-core at commits 69b2da9826df (parent of fix) and d3c2eee16b15 (fix, release 3.1.1). See fixtures/source-snapshots/provenance.json.
